decided: The user guide's glossary now says that a change's history also holds, in its own folder, the change's account.
alternatives: leave the glossary naming only the reviews, run summaries and decision records, with the account described only on the command reference page
why: The glossary is where a reader learns what a change's history holds; without the account there it reads as complete while leaving one of its folders out.

relies_on.title: Every H2 section of four concept pages declares its owner on a checked Carried by line

defines.definition: a change's plain-language record of what it built, the new places the user is asked something, and where the work left its plan
the folder beside a change that keeps every review, run summary and record written about it
